title: Rank One Abelian Stark Conjecture
exact_target: Can all the relevant partial-zeta derivatives be realized by logarithms of conjugates of a single permitted unit whose root generates an abelian extension?

sources.citation: S. Dasgupta and M. Greenberg, The Rank One Abelian Stark Conjecture, Arizona Winter School 2011 course notes, March 11, 2011.
